name: Coral
avoid_for: Contexts that should feel quiet or institutional — the coral accent and oversized Bebas Neue commit hard to a confident magazine voice
weak_cases: Long headings and many competing regions dilute the poster hierarchy.
visual_signature: Condensed uppercase display with coral/ink/cream regions and restrained hatch texture.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Condensation and uppercase are central; non-Latin substitutions must be rebalanced rather than width-matched.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
